name: Punjab
summary: The north-western wheat belt. Food is hearty and dairy-rich, with tandoor-baked breads, ghee, paneer and slow-cooked gravies.

name: Karnataka
summary: A south-western state with a strong tradition of fermented rice-and-lentil batters. The Udupi temple-town kitchens are famous for vegetarian cooking.

name: West Bengal
summary: A river-delta region where rice and freshwater fish anchor meals. Mustard in oil, paste and seed form is a defining flavour, and sweets are a major craft.

name: Gujarat
summary: A largely vegetarian western state. Meals balance sweet, salty and tangy notes, and gram-flour snacks (farsan) are a specialty.

name: Campania
summary: The region around Naples. Volcanic soil produces prized tomatoes, and buffalo mozzarella and pizza are its best-known exports.

name: Emilia-Romagna
summary: A rich agricultural region in the north. Egg pasta, cured pork, Parmigiano Reggiano and slow-simmered meat sauces define it.

name: Sicily
summary: A Mediterranean island shaped by Greek, Arab, Norman and Spanish rule. Rice, saffron, citrus, almonds and street food are all part of it.

name: Lombardy
summary: A northern region centred on Milan. Butter, rice from the Po valley and braised meats take the place of the olive oil used further south.

name: Oaxaca
summary: A southern state with strong indigenous traditions. It is known as the land of seven moles, along with chocolate, mezcal and tlayudas.

name: Yucatan
summary: A peninsula with Maya roots. Cooking uses achiote, sour orange, habanero and pit or banana-leaf techniques.

name: Puebla
summary: A central highland state with a colonial convent-kitchen heritage. It is the home of mole poblano and chiles en nogada.

name: Veracruz
summary: The Gulf coast state and main historical port. Seafood, tomatoes, olives and capers show the Spanish influence, alongside African and Caribbean flavours.
